## Rio by Night: Brazilian Dancing and Dinner at a Churrascaria

In [Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/), music and dance are part of life far beyond the Carnival season. The Ada Tours evening excursion combines **a live music show, traditional dancing and dinner at a churrascaria**. It is an opportunity to experience Brazilian performing arts and enjoy local food after a day of sightseeing.

The show features performers wearing colorful costumes. The venue, performance length, lineup and timetable must be confirmed when booking. The general description alone therefore does not establish a particular theater, guaranteed acts or a fixed starting time.

## What Music and Dancing Can You Expect?

Brazil's music culture is much broader than one style. Rio is especially well known for samba, and local stage shows often feature traditional dance forms. **We offer live music and traditional dances**, but the exact lineup of acts must be confirmed before your trip. If seeing a particular style matters to you, ask about the performance program in advance.

An evening stage show is not the same as the official Carnival parade of samba schools at the Sambadrome. The parade takes place on specific festival dates and requires separate arrangements and tickets. For that event, choose [Carnival trips](/interests/events-and-festivals/) and check the dates instead of assuming an ordinary evening show includes a parade.

## Dinner at a Traditional Churrascaria

A churrascaria is a restaurant specializing in Brazilian meat prepared over a fire or on a grill. The dining format varies by restaurant: some offer successive servings of different cuts, while others have a different ordering and service arrangement.

For this excursion, **churrascaria dinner is included in the stated evening program**. The menu, number of courses, drinks and arrangements for guests with dietary restrictions must nevertheless be agreed before booking. These details need separate confirmation. A particular choice of dishes, open bar or named restaurant cannot be promised.

Travelers curious about Brazilian cuisine in other regions may enjoy [Ada Tours' food and wine selection](/interests/food-and-wine/). It answers a different travel interest from this particular evening in Rio.

## What Does “Additional Payment” Mean?

The excursion has a specific condition: **the show and dinner are charged separately**. This is important when adding the evening to a multi-day Brazil trip. Even if the main tour has already been booked, the price of this program should not be considered part of the tour fare without separate confirmation.

| Confirmed | To Be Confirmed |
|---|---|
| Live music and dancing | Repertoire and venue |
| Churrascaria dinner | Menu and drinks |
| Additional payment | Exact price and transfer |

Choose the evening with the daytime itinerary in mind: after a flight or a long road journey, a full performance may be tiring. It is especially useful to confirm your return time to the hotel, appropriate clothing and any age restrictions imposed by the venue.

## Who Is This Evening Excursion For?

The experience suits travelers who have already explored Rio's beaches and viewpoints and want to devote several hours to the city's cultural life. For example, after a daytime visit to [Sugarloaf Mountain](/brazil/place/sugarloaf-mountain/) or [Corcovado](/brazil/place/corcovado-christ-the-redeemer/), the show can be added if the schedule and transport arrangements allow. Both daytime attractions are separate sights and are not automatically included in the dinner excursion.

Choosing between an evening show and a Carnival parade depends on the season and the desired experience. The former is a staged performance on an agreed evening; the latter is a major scheduled event in Rio's festival calendar.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Rio Evening Shows

### Is Dinner Included in the Excursion?

Yes. The program includes **live music, traditional dances and dinner at a churrascaria**. The specific dishes and drinks must be confirmed.

### Is This Excursion Already Included in the Main Tour Price?

No. The excursion description states that **the show and dinner are an additional charge**. A fixed price for the evening program is not given.

### Is This a Carnival Parade at the Sambadrome?

No. It is a separate evening stage program. Carnival parades take place on festival dates and are not implied by this excursion.

### Is a Transfer Provided?

Transport arrangements must be confirmed when booking. Agree on the meeting point and return transfer after the performance.

## Tours with an Evening Show and Churrascaria Dinner in Rio de Janeiro

The [“Rio by Night” dinner show](/brazil/rio-de-janeiro/rio-night-show-churrascaria-dinner/) combines performances to live music with a meal at a Brazilian churrascaria. Such an evening suits travelers who want to experience Brazil's music and dancing after daytime sightseeing. Dinner **is included in the separate evening excursion**, but that does not mean the excursion is included in the base price of a multi-day tour.

Our selection includes {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}} directly linked to this excursion. Unlike the general [Brazil tours catalog](/brazil/tour/), this selection is based on a specific evening activity. The venue, menu and exact performance timetable are not fixed in the available description, so it would be incorrect to promise an appearance by a particular group or an exact starting time.

## Adding the Evening Program to a Four-Day Rio Trip

On the [“4 Days in Rio de Janeiro: Sugarloaf Mountain and Christ the Redeemer” tour](/brazil/tour/rio-de-janeiro-four-days/), the show is offered on the evening of day 1 **for an additional charge**. During the day, travelers arrive, check into their hotel and rest after the flight. They can then choose the evening performance and dinner.

{{catalog.tourTable:tour_brazil_rio_four_days}}

The following days focus on sightseeing, including an ascent to [Sugarloaf Mountain](/brazil/place/sugarloaf-mountain/) and a visit to Corcovado with the [Christ the Redeemer statue](/brazil/place/corcovado-christ-the-redeemer/). This combination offers daytime visits to viewpoints and an evening of music and dinner. The additional program is arranged separately from the main excursions and does not change their duration or included services.

## What's Included in the Dinner Show, and What Belongs to the Tour?

The important distinction is between **the contents of the standalone excursion** and **the price of the longer journey**.

| Part of the Trip | How to Account for It |
|---|---|
| Evening show and churrascaria dinner | Together form a separate evening product |
| Four-day Rio tour | Evening product offered as an optional extra |

The evening excursion description includes live music, traditional dancing and dinner. It does not specify a confirmed fixed duration, restaurant address or separate price, so these details should not be treated as agreed conditions.

The main four-day tour includes private airport transfers, accommodation with breakfast and the daytime excursions listed in its itinerary. Adding the dinner show is a separate choice. Travelers should agree on the date, guiding language, meeting point and return transfer for the selected option.

## How Does This Differ from the Nighttime Samba and Capoeira Show?

We also offer a [nighttime samba and capoeira show](/brazil/rio-de-janeiro/rio-samba-capoeira-night-show/). Its standalone description features performers with music and dancing, while dinner is available **on request**. In the churrascaria program, dinner is already stated as part of the selected evening excursion. These are different travel products, and their conditions should not automatically be combined.

If your main interest is music and the performance, compare both descriptions. If you want a combination of a show and a traditional grilled-meat dinner, the churrascaria option is the more relevant one. You can explore [Brazilian food and wine experiences](/interests/food-and-wine/) separately: a churrascaria evening does not automatically make the entire journey a gastronomy tour.

## Choosing an Evening for the Event

During a short stay in Rio, compare arrival time, the length of daytime excursions and the following morning's schedule first. A late-night event after a long flight will not suit everyone; it is best chosen deliberately. Early departures to Corcovado or waterfalls in another city may be scheduled for the next day.

Itineraries with several days in [Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/) offer more flexibility, but a free evening does not itself confirm that a show has been booked. When choosing a tour, examine the exact inclusions, separate excursion modules and terms for additional services. This linked selection helps you start with a tour where the evening option is already offered.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Tours with an Evening Show in Rio

### Is Dinner Included in the Price of the Evening Excursion?

Yes. Churrascaria dinner is part of the standalone “Rio by Night: Evening Show and Churrascaria Dinner” product. However, on the confirmed four-day tour, this product is optional and its payment is not included in the base trip price.

### How Is a Churrascaria Different from an Ordinary Dinner Before a Show?

A churrascaria is a Brazilian-style restaurant specializing in meat dishes. Check the menu of the particular evening product: Ada Tours confirms dinner but does not list all dishes and drinks individually.

### Can You Combine the Show with Sugarloaf Mountain and Corcovado?

Yes. The four-day Rio itinerary features daytime visits to both attractions and the option of adding an evening program. Its specific date is coordinated with the selected tour schedule.

### Is There a Confirmed Fixed Price for the Show on This Page?

No fixed amount appears in the standalone evening product description. The price of the multi-day tour is not the fare for the show; the optional program must be considered separately.

## A Jeep Excursion Through Rocinha Favela in Rio de Janeiro

[Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/) comprises neighborhoods with different histories, buildings and ways of city life. **Rocinha** is a large residential district on the hills of southern Rio. Our excursion lets you discover it with an accompanying guide during a jeep ride, including stops to learn about local commerce.

The core itinerary covers Rocinha's streets, a market selling food and handmade goods, and a return transfer to the hotel. This is a tour of a lived-in neighborhood where people work and reside, so appropriate behavior and photography rules are especially important.

## What Travelers Will See

In Rocinha, densely packed buildings climb the slopes, while small shops, workshops and street vendors operate alongside homes. Roads and passages can be narrow, so much of the visit takes place at a pace suited to local conditions and the selected vehicle.

During the excursion, you will see **local street commerce, a food market and handicrafts**. This is an opportunity to understand the neighborhood's daily life, rather than seek extreme thrills. If you would like to buy something from vendors, bring a modest amount of cash and approach people respectfully.

A local accompanying guide helps explain everyday culture. Exact stops can vary depending on traffic and visiting conditions; the official itinerary does not promise entry into private homes or access to restricted spaces.

## Shared or Private Tour: What's the Difference?

Ada Tours offers 2 formats with different languages and prices:

| Format | Price |
|---|---|
| Shared group, English-speaking guide | $90 per person |
| Private tour, Russian-speaking guide | $170 per person |

**The private visit requires at least 2 participants.** Both options include guiding, a jeep trip through Rocinha and a return to the hotel. The excursion duration must be confirmed separately; it cannot be inferred from the price or title.

For travelers who value discussion in Russian and want to ask more questions along the way, the private option with a Russian-speaking guide is more suitable. The shared visit offers another price for the same general interest in the neighborhood.

## Respect for Residents and Photography Rules

Rocinha is a residential community. Please do not photograph people close up, children, home entrances or private situations without permission. Agree on the route and photography stops with your guide rather than turning the visit into an independent walk through unfamiliar streets.

Tours in urban neighborhoods depend on current conditions and local guides' recommendations. Safety and the feasibility of a particular visit must be reconfirmed shortly before departure. The existence of a tourism program does not mean there are no urban risks.

## Combining a Visit to Rocinha with Other Rio Experiences

Visiting Rocinha can be considered a separate social and cultural dimension of a Rio journey. To enjoy city panoramas, architecture and famous landmarks, choose another sightseeing itinerary. Current standalone offerings can be found in the [Rio excursions catalog](/brazil/rio-de-janeiro/).

Read more about the city on the [Rio de Janeiro page](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/), while itineraries highlighting local traditions appear under [Culture and History](/interests/culture-and-history/).

## Frequently Asked Questions About the Rocinha Excursion

### Can You Choose a Russian-Speaking Guide?

Yes. Ada Tours offers a private option with a Russian-speaking guide for $170 per person, with a minimum of 2 participants.

### What Does the Shared Group Cost?

$90 per person with an English-speaking guide.

### Is the Return Transfer to the Hotel Included?

Yes. Returning to the hotel is part of the excursion.

### Can You Photograph Residents?

Only with permission, respecting people's privacy and the guide's instructions. Photography must not disturb residents or breach visiting rules.

## Tours with a Jeep Excursion Through Rocinha

The [Rocinha jeep excursion](/brazil/rio-de-janeiro/rio-rocinha-favela-jeep-tour/) is a standalone city tour through a neighborhood of Rio de Janeiro. It includes riding along local streets, learning about street commerce, visiting a food and craft market, and returning to the hotel. This is a cultural and urban experience, not to be confused with visits to Rio's beaches or famous viewpoints.

Our selection includes {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}} in which this excursion is linked to the main program through a standalone module. **In all the confirmed itineraries, it is listed as an optional service**, so simply seeing the excursion among the possible activities does not mean it has been paid for.

## Two Options with Different Guides and Prices

The standalone excursion description specifies two options that are important to distinguish when selecting your tour.

| Option | Price |
|---|---|
| Shared group, English-speaking guide | **$90 per person** |
| Private, Russian-speaking guide | **$170 per person**, minimum 2 participants |

Both fares cover the Rocinha excursion, not the entire multi-day journey. They specify guiding, the jeep trip and return to the hotel. It would be incorrect to describe a Russian-speaking guide as included in the $90 shared-group option. The duration, stops and visit order should be taken from the confirmed individual offer, as the standalone page does not set out an hourly schedule.

## Which Ada Tours Journeys Can Be Enhanced with Rocinha?

### Champions' Parade, Iguaçu and Buenos Aires

On the [“Dreams Come True: Champions' Parade, Iguaçu and Buenos Aires” tour](/multi-country/tour/brazil-carnival-champions-parade-dreams/), the Rocinha excursion is listed among optional Rio outings. The main route combines Carnival experiences with later visits to Iguaçu and Buenos Aires. Rocinha offers a chance to devote separate time in Rio to learning about everyday urban life, provided the addition is coordinated with the main itinerary.

{{catalog.tourTable:tour_source_mechty_sbyvayutsya_na_parad_chempionov_karnavala}}

### Brazil, Argentina and Chile: Champions' Parade, Tango and Wine

On the [ten-day journey through Brazil, Argentina and Chile](/multi-country/tour/brazil-argentina-chile-champions-parade-10-days-2027/), Rocinha is also an optional outing. The itinerary explicitly lists both fares: $90 for a shared English-language option and $170 for a private Russian-language option with a minimum of 2 people.

{{catalog.tourTable:tour_brazil_argentina_chile_champions_parade_10_days_2027}}

A Carnival trip and a visit to Rocinha are different activities. The residential neighborhood is explored on a separate outing; it is not part of the parade, a samba school performance or a visit to the Sambadrome. If the parade is your main goal, choose its confirmed dates and program first, then add Rocinha only during a suitable free period.

## Visiting a Residential Neighborhood Respectfully

Rocinha is, above all, a place where people live and work. Visitors can learn about local commerce and the district's history while respecting residents' privacy. Photograph people only with permission; homes and ordinary passersby are not part of a staged tourist performance.

There are different approaches to favela tourism, including programs led by neighborhood residents. When selecting an optional excursion, it is reasonable to ask who accompanies the group locally and how the visit engages with the community. **We do not claim** that this product necessarily uses a guide who lives in Rocinha, and that status must not be attributed without separate confirmation.

A tour of an urban neighborhood requires following the guide's instructions and considering conditions on the day. Unrestricted movement through the district cannot be promised, nor can particular stops or photography opportunities. Pay special attention to group composition, guiding language and return arrangements.

## Fitting Rocinha into a Rio Journey

For Rio's classic panoramas, you can choose separate [Rio sightseeing tours](/brazil/tour/) featuring [Corcovado and Christ the Redeemer](/brazil/place/corcovado-christ-the-redeemer/), beaches or [Sugarloaf Mountain](/brazil/place/sugarloaf-mountain/). Rocinha adds a perspective on everyday urban life. On Carnival trips, it makes sense to protect the time allocated to paid main events before adding optional excursions.

Open the full page of your selected tour and compare not only its geography but also its exact inclusions, additional prices, guide languages and days spent in [Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/). Other [Brazil travel programs](/brazil/tour/) are available for visits without a Carnival focus; they are not necessarily linked to this excursion.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Tours Featuring Rocinha

### Is Rocinha Included in Carnival Tour Prices?

On both confirmed tours, the Rocinha jeep excursion is offered as an optional activity and charged separately. Inclusion depends on the selected program and excursion format.

### How Much Does a Russian-Speaking Guide Cost?

The private option costs **$170 per person**, with a minimum of 2 participants. The shared group costs $90 per person and has an English-speaking guide.

### Does Rocinha Replace a General Rio Sightseeing Tour?

No. It focuses on a specific residential district. Visits to Corcovado, Sugarloaf Mountain and other sights are determined by the separate tour itinerary.

### Can You Photograph Favela Residents?

Ask the people concerned and your accompanying guide before taking photographs. Respect privacy and residential spaces, even when the street appears open to tourists.

## Rio Night Show: Samba, Capoeira and Live Music

In [Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/), cultural experiences continue after sunset. Evening performances combine staged samba, live percussion rhythms and capoeira, where music accompanies complex movements and acrobatic sequences.

On Ada Tours' **“Samba and Capoeira Night Show”** program, a guide collects travelers from their hotel, accompanies them to the venue and arranges their return after the performance. An optional **dinner featuring Brazilian dishes** can be added. This is an important distinction from the [show-ticket-only option](/brazil/rio-de-janeiro/rio-samba-capoeira-show-only/), which charges separately for transfers.

## What Happens During the Evening Show?

Dancers in colorful costumes perform onstage to live music and drums. **Samba** reflects Brazilian urban music traditions, while **capoeira** combines playful, acrobatic and martial elements with rhythmic accompaniment.

Capoeira developed from Afro-Brazilian cultural practices. In its traditional form, participants form a circle and respond to one another through movement, accompanied by singing and instruments. UNESCO inscribed the “Capoeira Circle” on its Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2014.

A stage show is one way of discovering the art, not full participation in its traditional practice. This product does not include a dance lesson or capoeira training.

## What's Included and How Is the Visit Organized?

We arrange the evening in this sequence: **hotel pickup — accompaniment by the guide — evening performance — return to the hotel**. This is convenient for travelers who prefer to settle their evening logistics in advance.

Dinner may be added as an option. It is not listed as a compulsory part of the program, so the specific menu, restaurant and price must be confirmed for the selected version. Performance duration and lineup depend on the venue.

**No fixed price, exact start time or theater name is specified for this excursion.** Such details must not be copied automatically from another Rio night show, even if it also features samba and capoeira performers.

## How Is This Program Different from Carnival?

An evening show and the Carnival samba-school parade are different formats. During Carnival, the Sambadrome hosts major performances with their own calendar and ticketing system. A nighttime stage show is a standalone cultural activity, and its specific dates are set by the venue.

If travelers are more interested in the history of the music or visiting samba-school rehearsals, there are other themed excursions. The city's [excursions catalog](/brazil/rio-de-janeiro/) helps compare options by their actual included services.

## Preparing for an Evening Out

Confirm the hotel meeting time, dress requirements, dinner availability and photography or filming rules with the manager. Performances take place in the evening, so it is sensible to arrange the return beforehand, especially if your hotel is far from the venue.

If traveling with young children, ask about age restrictions for the selected show and its length; these conditions are not specified for this excursion.

## Frequently Asked Questions About the Samba and Capoeira Night Show

### Is a Hotel Transfer Included?

The guide meets guests at the hotel and accompanies them back after the performance. The exact transport arrangements are confirmed when booking.

### Can You Book Dinner?

Yes. Dinner with Brazilian dishes is available **as an option**. Its cost and conditions are agreed for the selected venue.

### How Much Does the Excursion Cost?

No fixed price is set for this excursion. It must not be replaced with the price of another show.

### How Does This Differ from the $120 Show?

The [other Ada Tours evening option](/brazil/rio-de-janeiro/rio-samba-capoeira-show-only/) is priced at $120 per person for the ticket only, with a separately charged transfer. This program includes a guide accompanying guests from their hotel and back, with an optional dinner.
